phone.name: Nocturne
phone.tooOld.title: This browser is too old
phone.tooOld.body: Nocturne can’t keep this phone safe in this browser. Update it, or open this page in a newer one.
phone.welcome.title: Add this phone from your computer
phone.welcome.body: On your computer, open Nocturne, choose Away from home, then Add a phone. Scan the code with this phone, or type it here.
phone.welcome.unreached: Your computer may still list this phone. Remove it there too.
phone.welcome.waiting: {count, plural, one {# thing is} other {# things are}} still waiting on this phone.
phone.scan.hint.pair: Point at the code on your computer’s screen, under “Add a phone”.
phone.scan.hint.relink: Point at the code on your computer’s screen. It’s under “Your phones need the new address”.
phone.scan.privacy: Nocturne uses the camera only while this is open, and keeps no pictures.
phone.scan.noCamera: The camera isn’t available here. Allow it in your browser, or type instead.
phone.scan.wrong: That isn’t a code from your computer. Try again.
phone.scan.camera: Camera view, looking for the code on your computer
phone.iphone.label: On iPhone
phone.iphone.title: Add Nocturne to your Home Screen
phone.iphone.step1: Tap **Share** at the bottom of Safari.
phone.iphone.step2: Scroll down and tap **Add to Home Screen**.
phone.iphone.note.title: You may need to pair once more
phone.iphone.note.body: On iPhone, the Home Screen app keeps its own storage, apart from Safari. If it asks when you first open it, add it as a phone from your computer again. It’s quick.
phone.typed.label: Adding this phone
phone.typed.title: Type the code from your computer
phone.typed.lead: It’s under the code to scan, in four groups of six.
phone.typed.hint: Capitals come by themselves. The letter o counts as 0, and the letters i and l count as 1.
phone.typed.next: Next, you name this phone and check three words on both screens.
phone.typed.warning: Your computer only asks you to allow a phone after this phone shows three words. If it asks before that, refuse it.
phone.typed.bad: That code isn’t right. Check it against your computer and try again.
phone.typed.noAnswer: Your computer didn’t answer. The code may have run out. Get a new one on your computer and try again.
phone.pair.label: Adding this phone
phone.pair.title: Name this phone
phone.pair.lead: Your computer shows this name in its list of phones, so pick one you’ll recognise.
phone.pair.next: Next, this phone and your computer each show three words. You check they match, then allow it on the computer.
phone.pair.private: This phone keeps no copy of your memory. It only shows things while you look at them.
phone.pair.badName: Use up to 40 letters and numbers, with nothing hidden or special.
phone.check.label: Adding {name}
phone.check.title: Check your computer shows the same three words.
phone.check.body: If they match, choose **Allow** on your computer. If they don’t, choose Don’t allow there and start again.
phone.check.warning: If your computer asks to allow a phone and this phone isn’t showing three words, someone else is trying to pair. Refuse it.
phone.allowed.title: {name} can now use Nocturne.
phone.allowed.body: Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app, straight to Ask, Keep and Today’s page.
phone.problem.refused.title: Your computer said no.
phone.problem.refused.body: Nothing was added. If that wasn’t what you meant, start again from your computer.
phone.problem.expired.title: This code has run out.
phone.problem.expired.body: Codes last five minutes and work once. Get a new one on your computer.
phone.problem.spent.title: This code can’t be used again.
phone.problem.spent.body: Each code works once. Get a new one on your computer and start again.
phone.home.ask.title: Ask
phone.home.ask.hint: Every answer shows where it came from.
phone.home.keep.title: Keep
phone.home.keep.hint: A note, a photo or a voice note.
phone.home.page.title: Today’s page
phone.home.private: Things you marked private stay on your computer.
phone.home.sent: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} you kept went across.
phone.asleep.title: {name} is asleep, switched off or has a new address.
phone.asleep.body: Things you keep now wait on this phone and go across when it’s back.
phone.asleep.mostPrivate: If you use Most private, check Tailscale is on.
phone.cantConnect.title: Can’t connect to {name} right now.
phone.cantConnect.body: This phone is still paired. Things you keep wait here and go across when it works again.
phone.asleep.keep.hint: Still works. {count, plural, =0 {Things you keep wait here.} one {# thing is waiting here.} other {# things are waiting here.}}
phone.asleep.ask.hint: Back when your computer is. Answers come from it.
phone.asleep.page.hint: Back when your computer is. This phone keeps no copy.
phone.asleep.address.title: Has your computer got a new address?
phone.asleep.last: Last connected {when} · tries again by itself
phone.asleep.never: Not connected yet · tries again by itself
phone.off.title: Away from home is off.
phone.off.body: It was turned off on {name}, so this phone can’t reach Nocturne. Turn it on there to use this phone again. This phone is still paired.
phone.off.keep.hint: You can still keep things. They wait on this phone until it’s back on.
phone.address.where: On your computer, open Nocturne and choose “Your phones need the new address”.
phone.outdated.title: This phone needs adding again.
phone.outdated.body: Your computer has been updated and this phone’s copy of Nocturne is too old to talk to it. Add this phone again from your computer. Nothing has been removed, and what’s waiting on this phone stays here.
phone.relink.title: Type the four words
phone.relink.lead: They’re on your computer, under the code. Capitals don’t matter.
phone.relink.hint: New words come with every new address, so old ones stop working.
phone.relink.failed: That address didn’t answer. Check the words, and that your computer is awake.
phone.relink.here.title: Open Nocturne from your home screen
phone.relink.here.body: This page can’t reconnect a phone by itself. Open Nocturne from the home screen, choose “Scan the new code”, then point it at your computer.
phone.removed.title: This phone was removed from Nocturne.
phone.removed.body: To use it again, pair it from your computer.
phone.removed.waiting: {count, plural, one {# thing was} other {# things were}} still waiting on this phone.
phone.removed.waitingBody: {count, plural, one {It didn’t} other {They didn’t}} go across. {count, plural, one {It stays} other {They stay}} here until you pair again, or you clear {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
phone.removed.confirm.title: Clear what’s waiting?
phone.removed.confirm.body: {count, plural, one {# thing waiting here is} other {# things waiting here are}} deleted from this phone. They can’t be brought back.
phone.sheet.title: This phone
phone.sheet.name: Name
phone.sheet.can: This phone can ask, keep and read today’s page. It can’t delete, forget, export or change settings.
phone.sheet.disconnect.hint: It stops working until you pair it again from your computer.
phone.sheet.confirm.title: Disconnect this phone?
phone.sheet.confirm.body: It stops working until you pair it again from your computer.
phone.sheet.confirm.waiting: {count, plural, one {# thing waiting here stays} other {# things waiting here stay}} on this phone until you clear {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
phone.keep.title: Keep
phone.keep.fromName: On your computer it will say “Kept from {name}”.
phone.keep.photo.alt: The photo you are about to keep
phone.keep.kept.body: Your computer has it. It reads it shortly, and the dates can turn up on tomorrow’s page.
phone.keep.undone: Taken back. It’s no longer kept.
phone.keep.undo.late: It’s too late to take that back from the phone. Do it on your computer.
phone.keep.waiting.body: It’s on this phone and goes across when your computer is back. You can leave this page.
phone.keep.big.title: Too big to keep from a phone.
phone.keep.big.body: The limit is 50 MB. Keep it from your computer instead.
phone.keep.failed.title: That didn’t go across.
phone.keep.failed.body: Nothing was kept. Try again in a moment.
phone.keep.kind.title: Nocturne can’t keep that.
phone.keep.kind.body: From a phone, it keeps notes, photos, PDFs and voice notes.
phone.keep.micDenied: The microphone isn’t available. Allow it in your browser and try again.
phone.keep.micNone: Recording isn’t available in this browser.
phone.record.hint: Hold the phone near whoever is speaking. You can put it down on the table.
phone.ask.title: Ask
phone.ask.empty.title: Ask about anything you’ve kept.
phone.ask.empty.body: Nocturne answers only from what you’ve kept, and shows where each answer came from.
phone.ask.example.2: What did we decide about half term?
phone.ask.waking: Waking up. The first answer of the day takes a little longer.
phone.ask.cameLater: Where this came from shows when the answer ends.
phone.ask.from: From {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} you kept
phone.ask.wrong: Something wrong? Correct it on your computer.
phone.ask.question: “{question}”
phone.ask.notSure.lead: Not sure. {count, plural, one {This comes} other {These come}} close, and they can’t all be right.
phone.ask.notSure.hint: Choose which is right on your computer and Nocturne will remember.
phone.ask.nothing.body: Nocturne only answers from what you keep. A photo, a note or a voice note about it would do it.
phone.ask.notReady: Nocturne is getting ready. Ask again in a moment.
phone.ask.tooMany: That’s a lot of questions at once. Wait a moment, then ask again.
phone.ask.failed: The answer stopped because your computer couldn’t be reached. Ask again in a moment.
phone.ask.paused: Nocturne is paused on your computer, so it can’t answer right now.
phone.original.failed: That didn’t open. Your computer may be asleep. Try again in a moment.
phone.original.private: That one stays on your computer.
phone.original.gone: That one is no longer kept.
phone.original.zoom: Pinch to zoom. Shown from your computer; nothing is saved on this phone.
phone.original.text: Shown from your computer; nothing is saved on this phone.
phone.original.cantShow: This one can’t be shown on the phone. Open it on your computer.
phone.original.download: Save a copy on this phone
phone.original.cantShowHere: This one can’t be shown on this phone. Save a copy on this phone to open it somewhere else.
phone.original.cut: Only the start is shown here. Open it on your computer to read the rest.
phone.original.used: The highlighted part is what the answer used.
phone.original.voice: Played from your computer; nothing is saved on this phone.
phone.original.document.hint: It opens in your browser’s viewer. Viewing it saves nothing on this phone. Saving a copy does.
phone.page.title: Today’s page
phone.page.edition: Phone edition · private lines left out
phone.page.which: Choose which is right on your computer.
phone.page.none.body: The first page arrives after Nocturne has read what you kept overnight.
phone.page.failed: That didn’t open. Your computer may be asleep. Try again in a moment.
phone.page.pending: {count, plural, one {# thing is} other {# things are}} still waiting to be read.
